customer: hey, just moved to texas and want to sell my cargo van but my ex wife is stil on the title. do i realy need her to sign anything? we're divorced and the van went to me in the setlement
agent: Thanks for reaching out! Per our article "My ex is still on the title," an ex-spouse who's still listed on the title normally has to sign, just like any co-owner. However, if your divorce decree awards the van to you, you can bring a certified copy of the decree and your ex's signature won't be needed. Also, if your name changed in the divorce, take a look at "The name on the title doesn't match my ID."
